newsitem.title: UK: EMS/MARK HOVERS AT HIGHS AFTER JUMP ON BUBA REPORT.
newsitem.headline: EMS/MARK HOVERS AT HIGHS AFTER JUMP ON BUBA REPORT.

text.p: 0805 GMT - Mark crosses steady at highs after jump on Buba report warning pace of inflation picked up and it will steer policy to ensure price stability. Says will observe forex moves closely, assess inflation risks. Dlr/mark just off lows.

* Mark/French franc at 3.3716/18 vs 3.3698/3.3703 in late Europe on Tuesday. Mark/Swiss at 82.20/22 vs 81.88/91. Mark/lira at 977.60/7.80 vs 976.25/55 and touch up against Norwegian crown at 4.1155/85 vs 4.1080/4.1110.

* Buba warned pace of consumer price increases had picked up in last few months and it would be steering policy to ensure inflation remained under control. "The Bundesbank will orientate its policy in such a way that price stability, which has been essentially achieved, can be maintained."
* German retail sales in June +2.0 pct in real terms, +3.0 pct nominally. H1 97 retail sales -1.0 pct real. July wholesale prices -1.0 pct m/m, +2.0 pct y/y.
* Buba says German 97 tax receipts likely less than govt's latest estimate, says "large sweeping" reforms only way out.
* Bavarian premier Stoiber has talked of a plan to delay launch of EMU from 1999 to 2001, Dutch newspaper Algemeen Dagblad says.
